description: Personalized picks in one city for a traveler's interests, favourite periods, preference for headline sights or hidden gems, indoor or outdoor, and time available. Each pick says why it was chosen. Use plan_walking_tour instead when the traveler wants an ordered route.

available_minutes.description: Total visit time available; picks stop when it is used up.

city_id.description: Gingerguide city id, e.g. "rome" or "istanbul" (from search_cities).

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

style.description: must_see favours each city's headline sights, hidden_gems favours lesser-known ones, balanced mixes both.

name: recommend_attractions
title: Recommend attractions
